Search request with max_results parameter limiting response count

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	req := pkg.SearchRequest{
		Model:      `brave/web-search`,
		Query:      `Rust programming`,
		MaxResults: ptr(uint32(2)),
	}
		client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Search(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results)
}
```
